page_title: LEV 4-0 BOC | Bayer Leverkusen v Bochum 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Daniel Schlager is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

90+2' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Gustavo Puerta (Bayer Leverkusen). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
89' Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
87' The game has come to an end for Florian Wirtz. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen).
87' Thomas Letsch has decided to substitute Anthony Losilla and he is replaced by Tim Oermann (Bochum).
86' The Bochum players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
83' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
81' Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
78' The ball possession is 65:35.
76' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
75' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
74' The attendance for today's match is 30210.
73' Substitution. Piero Hincapie makes his way off the pitch and Gustavo Puerta (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as his replacement.
73' Jonas Hofmann will be replaced by Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen).
73' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
69' Thomas Letsch has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Noah Loosli (Bochum) replacing Erhan Masovic.

69' 4 - 0 Goal! Florian Wirtz produces a great pass that finds Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the left side of the goal. 4:0.
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) for Jonathan Tah.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Patrik Schick.
67' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
66' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

66' Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Bochum will take a corner.
64' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bayer Leverkusen due to an offside in the build-up play.
63' Wait! Referee Daniel Schlager has indicated he is going to review the Bayer Leverkusen goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
63' It will be a substitution. Philipp Forster (Bochum) is ready to enter the pitch as Goncalo Paciencia walks off.
63' Here is a change. Christopher Antwi-Adjei is going off and Thomas Letsch gives the last tactical orders to Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).

62' Alejandro Grimaldo showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 4:0.
60' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
60' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Bayer Leverkusen get a corner.
59' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Manuel Riemann, who smothers the ball.
57' Matus Bero (Bochum) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
55' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
54' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
51' It's like he was asking for a caution. Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) receives a yellow card.
51' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post.
50' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' Thomas Letsch makes a switch. Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum) is coming on in place of Takuma Asano at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+1' 3 - 0 Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 3:0.
45+1' The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
42' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Manuel Riemann earns his money with a fine reflex save.
39' This is a yellow card! Erhan Masovic (Bochum) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
37' Bochum enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
35' The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner.

35' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it! Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.

32' 2 - 0 Goal! Jeremie Frimpong produces a great pass that finds Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
30' 1 - 0 Goal! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Manuel Riemann to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
30' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

29' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee makes the call - penalty to Bayer Leverkusen!

28' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
27' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
24' Bernardo (Bochum) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Lukas Hradecky is alert and denies him.
23' Bayer Leverkusen show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
21' One of the players from Bochum times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' Some patient build-up play from Bayer Leverkusen as they look to unlock the defence.
17' A long pass, executed by Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
16' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
15' Bochum fail to score from a corner as Lukas Hradecky (Bayer Leverkusen) leaps to collect the ball.
14' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
13' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
12' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
11' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box.
11' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
10' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
9' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Half-chance! Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a pass into the box, but Manuel Riemann reacts well to snuff out the attack.
6' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Bernardo (Bochum). Daniel Schlager saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Bayer Leverkusen.
5' The ball is cleared after Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Bochum will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniel Schlager.
